requirement: Exact donor motorcycle year and variant shall be recorded
notes: Do not publish VIN or registration identifiers

requirement: Target route speed payload duty cycle and charging context shall be defined
notes: No range or power sizing before this

requirement: Vehicle mass and maximum permitted mass shall be evidenced
Motor mount loads shall be calculated for peak torque and vibration
source_or_basis: Motor datasheet and measured frame geometry

requirement: Battery and motor mass distribution shall preserve acceptable handling and load limits
source_or_basis: Measured baseline and selected component data

requirement: Braking performance shall be no worse than accepted baseline and applicable law
source_or_basis: Applicable DLT rules and qualified review

requirement: Traction and auxiliary power domains shall be documented
Overcurrent protection shall be coordinated with conductors and components
Isolation and emergency shutdown concept shall be documented
source_or_basis: Applicable rules and qualified engineering review

requirement: Pack safety evidence and BMS fault responses shall be available
Charger shall be compatible with exact pack chemistry and BMS limits
Unexpected propulsion shall be prevented by interlocks and fault handling
verification_method: State-machine review and fault injection in safe simulator
notes: Define safe state and reset policy

requirement: Ingress corrosion vibration and temperature limits shall be suitable for local use
notes: IP rating alone is not whole-system qualification

requirement: Consumables and critical spares shall have at least one qualified alternate source
Applicable vehicle category and conversion approval path shall be confirmed in writing
notes: Separate Motor Vehicle Act and Land Transport Act

requirement: Every safety-critical requirement shall have an acceptance criterion and evidence record
notes: No pass by document presence alone

requirement: Conversion shall be compared with petrol and factory-EV alternatives on equivalent workload
source_or_basis: Local quotes and measured use data

requirement: Final owner and emergency documentation shall describe actual configuration
